'''Eitan''' ([[Hebrew]] for "steadfast", "firm" or "strong") is an [[armored fighting vehicle|armoured fighting vehicle]] (AFV) developed by the [[Merkava]] and Armoured Vehicles Directorate in the [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|IMOD]] to replace the ageing [[M113 armored personnel carrier|M113 armoured personnel carrier]] in use by the [[Israel Defense Forces]].<ref>{{cite news |last=Fabian |first=Emanuel |title=Defense Ministry to deliver first new advanced 'Eitan' APC to IDF |url=https://www.timesofisrael.com/defense-ministry-to-deliver-first-new-advanced-eitan-apc-to-idf/ |access-date=2023-03-29 |website=[[The Times of Israel]] |language=en-US |issn=0040-7909}}</ref>
Its [[armored personnel carrier]] (APC) variant lacks the [[Iron Fist (countermeasure)|Iron Fist]] [[Active protection system|APS]], due to the fact those are not the serial production Eitan vehicles yet. The [[infantry fighting vehicle]] (IFV) variant is still not in service.

==Overview==
[[File:Nahal Brigade, 2020. XIII.jpg|thumb|left|An Eitan of the [[Nahal Brigade]] in 2020]]

The Eitan is an 8-wheeled vehicle much lighter than any other 8- wheeled AFV Israel has produced [[Namer]], weighing less than 35 tons,<ref>{{cite web|last=Opall |first=Barbara |url=http://www.defensenews.com/story/defense/land/2016/08/01/israel-unveils-wheeled-actively-protected-armored-carrier/87907090/ |title=Israel Unveils Wheeled, Actively Protected Armored Carrier |publisher=Defense News |date=4 August 2016 |access-date=4 August 2016}}{{dead link|date=August 2021|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref> fitted with the [[Iron Fist (countermeasure)|Iron Fist Light Decoupled]] [[active protection system]].<ref>[https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/israeli-ministry-of-defense-selects-elbit-systems-iron-fist-light-decoupled-active-protection-system-for-the-eitan-afv-895792789.html Israeli Ministry of Defense Selects Elbit Systems' Iron Fist Light Decoupled Active Protection System for the Eitan AFV]. ''PRNewswire''. 20 August 2019.</ref> The AFV has a top speed of 90&nbsp;km/h and can carry up to 12 soldiers including 3 crew. The Eitan can be equipped with a 30–40&nbsp;mm gun and a missile firing position with 2 [[Spike (missile)|Spike]] missiles.<ref>{{Cite news | url=http://www.globes.co.il/en/article-the-idfs-first-wheeled-armored-personnel-carrier-unveiled-1001143339 | title=Israel unveils its first wheeled APC | newspaper=Globes | date=8 January 2016 }}</ref> The armour is rated to the standard [[STANAG 4569#Level 4|STANAG 4569 level 4]].

The Eitan will replace hundreds of M113 APC currently in service.<ref name="auto">{{cite web|last=Eshel |first=Tamir |url=http://defense-update.com/20160801_eitan.html |title=Israel Develops a Highly Protected APC to Replace Thousands of M-113 'Tin Cans' |publisher=Defense Update |date=1 August 2016 |access-date=18 August 2016}}</ref> According to Brigadier General Baruch Matzliah, the vehicle will complement, not replace, the Namer tracked APC;<ref>{{cite web |last=Lappin |first=Yaakov |url=http://www.janes.com/article/62755/israel-unveils-first-wheeled-apc |title=Israel unveils first wheeled APC |publisher=IHS Janes |date=4 August 2016 |access-date=4 August 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160804191742/http://www.janes.com/article/62755/israel-unveils-first-wheeled-apc |archive-date=2016-08-04 |url-status=dead }}</ref> as a wheeled vehicle, it will cost half as much as the Namer ($3 million) and, unlike tracked vehicles, can transport infantry squads on roads without relying on [[tank transporter]]s.

The Eitan has the capability to use [[run-flat tires]] and is designed with a [[Non-explosive reactive armor|NERA composite armour]] and high floor to protect from landmine and [[improvised explosive device|IED]] blast effects.<ref name="auto"/> The first Eitan AFV was unveiled on August 1, 2016.<ref>{{cite web|last=Lapin |first=Yaakov |url=https://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/WATCH-Defense-Ministry-unveils-IDFs-first-wheeled-armored-personnel-carrier-462936 |title=The Eitan APC will come with an active protection system, and its high speed will enable rapid deployment of forces between North and South. armor STANAG 4569 level 4 |publisher=The Jerusalem Post |date=1 August 2016 |access-date=18 August 2016}}</ref>

Serial production started in 2022, and the [[Nahal Brigade]] became the first Israeli infantry unit to receive the Eitan in May 2023.<ref>[https://breakingdefense.com/2023/05/first-eitan-wheeled-apcs-delivered-to-israels-idf/ First Eitan wheeled APCs delivered to Israel’s IDF]. ''Breaking Defense''. 31 May 2023.</ref> The brigade first used the Eitan during the [[Battle of Zikim]] on 7 October 2023, and there were plans to use the vehicle in the subsequent [[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|invasion of the Gaza Strip]].<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://news.walla.co.il/item/3617021 | date= October 18, 2023 | publisher = [[Walla! News]] | title=טבילת האש הראשונה: נגמ"ש "האיתן" חיסל מחבלים בחוף זיקים | language=he}}</ref>
